integrity: The claim is proved analytically from regular-simplex Gram identities, the exact projection density of spherical measure, inclusion-exclusion, and a beta integral. The packaged checker verifies algebraic identities only and is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact union formula covers only the first interval in which triple overlaps are present and positive-measure quadruple overlaps are absent. The onset asymptotic is stated for \(n\ge5\); no numerical improvement to the source illumination table is claimed.
title: Exact third-order union formula at the first multiple-overlap threshold for simplex-centred spherical caps
